notes.title: A Frozen Pirate Carol!
notes.notes:
[img]http://content.puzzlepirates.com/images/spyglass/2016dec/team_comp.png[/img]

The brigands 'n barbarians have frost in thar soul this season.  Ye ghosts of holidays past, present and future must “encourage” thar holiday cheer whilst pillagin' the seas.  Defeatin' these scrooge-ish brigands 'n barbarians will surely bring some piratey cheer back to our oceans.

[b]From now until the 2nd of January[/b], ye pirates have been turned into a ghost o' holidays past, present or future! Load up a ship 'n take to the seas, earnin' points fer yer team fer every piece o' eight ye wrest from the hands of the miserly brigands!

[b]A Box of Frozen Cheer![/b]

[img]http://content.puzzlepirates.com/images/spyglass/2016dec/blizzard_box.png[/img]

The arctic wind is starting to howl across the sea.  Pirates are eager to hide from the freezing temperatures and enjoy some carousin’ indoors with a mug of hot buttered rum in their hand. 

Yer expecting an entire crew full of pirates to descend on yer cabin to wile away the winter hours.  It’s entirely possible that ye’ll be trapped together if the storms don’t let up.  Don’t worry, we’ve got ye covered with our Blizzard Box.

Roast some chestnuts with help from an Ice Dragon Familiar fer yer crewmates to snack on.  Entertain them with a panda that ye’ve managed to convince to wear a bandana.  If they get scared by the icy wind, we have yeti dolls fer them to snuggle.  If pirates aren’t mingling, these chilly boxes include frozen furniture to help encourage them to vacate their seat.  Ye may even find some holiday favors or trinkets ye can give yer mates as parting gifts!

[b]Boxes are available until 3:00 PM PDT on January 2nd, 2017.  You'll receive a free Blizzard Box for every $9.99 you spend on [url=https://billing.puzzlepirates.com/billing/shared/select_type.jspx?choice=coins]doubloons[/url], or every month of [url=https://billing.puzzlepirates.com/billing/shared/select_type.jspx?choice=time]subscription[/url] time you purchase![/b]

For more information about the full contents of the Blizzard Box, as well as the official rules, please click [url=http://yppedia.puzzlepirates.com/Official:Dec16_Promotion]here[/url].

notes.title: Those Greedy Brigands
notes.notes:
[img]http://content.puzzlepirates.com/images/spyglass/2016sep/greedy_brigands_large.png[/img]

Avast, mates!

Greedy brigands 'n barbarians who 'ave selfishly hoarded bits o' booty fer themselves 'ave infiltrated the oceans.  Ye might spy some durin' the melee phase o' sea battle while out on a pillage.  Ye’ll recognize the blaggards by thar extravagant jewelry they can’t resist showin' off, such as gold eyepatches 'n flashy necklaces.

They 'ave one fatal flaw: each greedy brigand 'n barbarian has a weakness against one color.  Target thar weakness 'n plunder some o' thar Lavish Lockers filled wit' Pieces of Eight, along with exclusive new items, silver chromas, and rare creatures to call yer own.

Learn more about these dastardly foes and how to plunder thar treasure [url=https://yppedia.puzzlepirates.com/Greedy_brigand]here[/url]

notes.title: The Sloop is on Fire!
notes.notes:

The bow is designed to allow the ship to break through any obstacles ye may encounter on yer explorations. Ye'll also be glad to have deluxe engines and specially designed bilge pumps for the treacherous conditions!

[img]http://content.puzzlepirates.com/images/spyglass/2016mar/torrid.png[/img]

Visit yer local shipyard to today. The Torrid Class Ship is only available through March 31, 2016.

notes.title: Marriage is what brings us together.....
notes.notes:
Love, true love. We gather aboard this ship to celebrate that special love between two pirates. Invite yer close hearties, or the whole crew, for a celebration voyage aboard the limited edition [b]Lovestruck Class Sloop[/b]!

[img]http://content.puzzlepirates.com/images/spyglass/2016feb/lovestruck1.png[/img]

Ye'll find swabbies in their finest to greet yer guests and guide them below deck for the ceremony. There's a portrait easel conveniently located in the hold to help ye catch all the memories. Share rum and heart cookies after the ceremony. Then all hands to stations for the joyous voyage. Once yer out to sea, the happy couple can enjoy the fresh sea air while they open gifts. How many anchors do ye think the lucky couple received? Let any pirate who has an objection to this union, walk th' plank!

[img]http://content.puzzlepirates.com/images/spyglass/2016feb/lovestruck2.png[/img]

[b]Visit yer local shipyard to get your own little piece of bliss now through February 29, 2016.[/b]

notes.title: Sealpocalypse Now: A'uk's Revenge
notes.notes:
An Imperial excavation of an abandoned and forlorn village in the frozen north has unleashed an ancient curse upon the seas! Now Imperials and pirate are transformed and drawn into the battle between the Legions of A'uk and the ancient warrior Pengmunks.

The [b]Sealperials[/b] work to free King A'uk from his prison, so he can unleash his fury across the world. The spirits of the warrior Pengmonks have awoken and transformed pirates into [b]Swashbuckling Penguins[/b] to protect the Seal of the Dread Seal King A'uk's prision. Raid Sealperial Outposts to reclaim artefacts and ensure A'uk does not escape!

[img]http://content.puzzlepirates.com/images/spyglass/2015dec/sealpocalypsesm.png[/img]

Each ocean has been divided into 4 teams, with pirates from the same crew all being placed on the same team.  Pirates can participate and earn points for their team by raiding Sealperial Outposts, collecting artefact pieces and assembling them near the docks on certain islands. Artefacts grant Swashbuckling Penguins furniture items: [b]Ancient Tablets[/b], [b]Crystal Seals[/b] and [b]Penguin Idols[/b]. Full details can be found [url=http://yppedia.puzzlepirates.com/Official:Team_Competitions]here[/url].

The competition ends on [b]Monday, January 4 at 3 PM PST[/b].

notes.title: Bah, Humbug!
notes.notes:
Scrooge was a cold, hard man who enjoyed his gold and scowled fiercely at anyone who would take it from him. He'd be an excellent pirate! Arrr! Join with yer hearties aboard the [b]Scrooge Class Sloop[/b] and voyage with Scrooge through this holiday season!

[img]http://content.puzzlepirates.com/images/spyglass/2015dec/scrooge2.png[/img]

Do ye prefer bah, humbug or Merry Christmas? [b]Visit yer local shipyard to purchase a Scrooge Class Sloop now through January 3, 2016[/b].

notes.title: Esteemed Explorers!
notes.notes:
The Imperial Expeditionary Society is an esteemed organization with the goal to explore and document the natural world. They are also known to boast at length about their incredible feats and experiences. An exclusive group with a strict dress code and social gatherings, they're also known to carry lavish curiosities and trinkets on their ships. [b]Valuable plunder for pirates![/b]
[img]http://content.puzzlepirates.com/images/spyglass/2015sep/explorer1.png[/img]
Alas, the Imperial Expeditionary Society rarely sails in these oceans, as they don't appreciate the pirate code of conduct. One member peered through his monocle and scoffed at the mention of pirates. Recently, a Society ship was [b][i]commandeered[/i][/b] by a few mateys, and now it's for sale in yer local shipyard! Too strange to strip down and sell for booty, this ship will inspire ye to set off on adventure to the unknown!
[img]http://content.puzzlepirates.com/images/spyglass/2015sep/explorer2.png[/img]
Enjoy the benefits of membership as ye gather around the Society's hidden bar to share a barrel o' rum and yer grand tales of adventure. Dress in yer finest as ye set off with esteem company to discover the unknown!

[b]The Explorer Class Sloop* will be available from yer local shipyard through September 30, 2015![/b]

[i]*Pirates are civilized. No animals were harmed in the creation of this ship.[/i]

notes.title: Mount Olympus Awaits!
notes.notes:
Long have the Greek deities watched over the oceans for amusement and to ensure justice. Now, the pantheon grants ye pirates a token of their favor. A sloop crafted to reflect the plenitude of Mount Olympus [i]based on the design by Pixelpixie of Cerulean.[/i]
[img]http://content.puzzlepirates.com/images/spyglass/2015jul/olympus1.png[/img]
Wherever ye roam on the ship, enjoy the opulence favored by the deities and heroes of ancient myth. Recline in the main hold as ye enjoy fresh fruits and the finest of wines. Share tales of yer grand quests with yer hearties. There's no duty stations here to disrupt yer merriment. 
[img]http://content.puzzlepirates.com/images/spyglass/2015jul/olympus2.png[/img]
When ye needs some quiet relaxation, retreat to the cabin. Soak away the stresses of the day in the lavish bath. 
[img]http://content.puzzlepirates.com/images/spyglass/2015jul/olympus3.png[/img]
Send the workers deep into the hold. From there, they won't disturb yer revelry. Keep yer treasures safe from thievin' pirates with a beastly labyrinth. If they successfully navigate the maze, they'll be unlikely to survive the dreadful gaze o' the Gorgon!

May Artemis, the goddess of the hunt, guide your journey, and reward you with riches and epic tales of adventure! [b]The Olympus Class Sloop will be available from yer local shipyard through August 31, 2015![/b]

notes.title: A Tale o' Misadventure!
notes.notes:
Ye needs secrecy, skill, and a fair bit o' good luck to be a successful smuggler. The scurvy dogs of the crew, Miss Fortune, found themselves cursed with bad luck at every turn of the tide. Step aboard this bizarre vessel and hear the tall tale about their accursed journey.

[img]http://content.puzzlepirates.com/images/spyglass/2015may/calamity2.png[/img]
Now that they're home, they've given up the smugglin' trade. They're offering 3-hour tours around yer favorite archipelago while they regale ye with the tale of their fateful cruise. Don't worry about a bit o' bad luck. Stop by yer local shipyard and add a Calamity Class Cutter to yer collection today! [b]The Calamity Class Cutter will be available through June 30, 2015.[/b]

notes.title: INVADERS FROM SPACE!
notes.notes:
For years, pirates have been the apex predator of the seas, pillaging and plundering as they see fit without fear of reprisal - but that's all about to change! Extraterrestrial life forms have invaded the Oceans and now the hunters have become the hunted. What they want is a mystery but their force is undeniable!

Introducing [b]Alien Attack![/b] a brand new pillaging expedition!

EXPERIENCE:

[b]OUT OF THIS WORLD THRILLS![/b] - [i]Escape the clutches of your abductors and fight your way back to your ship[/i]

[b]OUT OF THIS WORLD CHILLS![/b] - [i]Run a gauntlet of Alien Scout, Hunter and Abductor ships and strange "Blue Fire" fences[/i]

[b]OUT OF THIS WORLD BOOTY![/b] - [i]Can you escape not only with your lives but with a hold full of Alien Pods containing never before seen treasures?[/i]
[img]http://content.puzzlepirates.com/images/spyglass/2015apr/alien_attacksm.png[/img]
Be alert! The seas are no longer safe! Abductions can happen at any moment and without warning. Once abducted your crew must fight its way through the alien hordes to reach your ship. That would be difficult enough, but that's not the end of it. The invading aliens do not take escape lightly and will stop at nothing to recapture you. Weave your way through searching [b]Scout ships[/b] whose spotlights will pinpoint your location for the waiting [b]Hunter ships[/b] - their strange cannons of light can tear through even the most reinforced hulls like a hot knife through butter. Strange barriers of blue fire will temporarily block your path so timing is of the utmost important. Worst of all is the massive [b]Abductor ship[/b]  - those that are recaptured have never been heard from again. 

Enterprising Captains have been able to turn misfortune into great fortune, however. Scattered around the Alien Mothership are [b]strange glowing pods[/b] filled with interstellar trinkets and treasures from countless alien worlds. Attempting to snatch them up is a great risk with the invading aliens hot on your heels - but the rewards are worth it!

The Alien Attack expedition is available starting today, [b][i]April 1, 2015[/i][/b]!

notes.title: Hopping Herbage!
notes.notes:
Did someone forget to give the gardeners their ration of rum? The new Verdant Class Baghlah looks a bit overgrown. There's something unsettling and wild about this new ship, so ye pirates will want to keep a weather eye out for indications of curses and other mischief while we take a tour. 

[img]http://content.puzzlepirates.com/images/spyglass/2015mar/verdant1.png[/img]

The main deck is covered in wild flowered vines and thick overgrowth, and even the ship's wheel has been replaced by a giant sun flower. The reflecting pond in the main hold is barely visible with all the green overgrowth. Pay close attention as ye wander this ship - ye never know what's hidden among all those plants!

[img]http://content.puzzlepirates.com/images/spyglass/2015mar/verdant2.png[/img]
The rabbits say ye may want to give the order to grab a hammer and man the bilge pumps. The aft hold is takin' on water! Did ye notice, the number of rabbits on this ship has multiplied compared to the Verdant Class Sloop. Where be th' swabbies? Perhaps they've gone to the cabin to alert the captain of the excess water in the hold.

[img]http://content.puzzlepirates.com/images/spyglass/2015mar/verdant3.png[/img]
Avast, me hearties! There be an ancient curse upon this vessel causing all the crew to be transformed into rabbits! The crew don't seem too upset by this transformation, and even seem content in their current state. They'll gladly give ye a tour through their rabbit warrens and let ye take the wheel for a spin. Who knows what ye'll find down the rabbit hole....

[img]http://content.puzzlepirates.com/images/spyglass/2015mar/verdant4.png[/img]

Set a course for a hopping good time and visit yer local shipyard today! The [b]Verdant Class Baghlah[/b] will be available through April 30, 2015.

notes.title: Yule Love this Festive Sloop!
notes.notes:
Daring pirates from the smuggler's guild recently 'acquired' designs for a new sloop. Rumored to have come from secret facilities in the icy northern realm of the Toymakers, the [b]Yuletide Class Sloop is based on the design by player Yoditay of Emerald[/b]. The ship is available to order from yer local shipyard for a limited time!

Could this be the ship sailed by the Dread Pirate Santa to deliver gifts to good pirate lads n' lasses? Let's step aboard and take a quick look!

[img]http://content.puzzlepirates.com/images/spyglass/2014dec/yuletide1.png[/img]

On the main deck ye'll find a treasure trove of goodies awaiting delivery. Merry cannons are found on the ship to protect the bounty from thieves and scoundrels. While he's known as a jolly pirate, the Dread Pirate Santa is sure to give no quarter to anyone who'd stop his seasonal deliveries. 

[img]http://content.puzzlepirates.com/images/spyglass/2014dec/yuletide2.png[/img]

Below deck, there's a space where workers put together last minute gifts and apply those finishing touches. It appears the Toymakers keep their workshops carefully guarded behind a wall of snow. Only those who know the secret steps can enter this space of ribbons and bows.

A list o' winners will be posted on the forums...[i]after[/i] we’ve had time to recover from the festivities.

notes.title: Beware the Kraken!
notes.notes:
For months, merchants from the Empire have reported an unusual number of ships missing or destroyed in previously quiet waters. Those lucky to survive the attacks report “Giant Snakes” emerging from the sea. The Brotherhood of Applied Cryptozoology has confirmed these were [b]kraken attacks[/b]!

This legendary sea monster was once only a whispered rumor - the mysterious source for Kraken’s Blood. Now, talk is swirling around pirate inns, claiming there are vast treasures to be found in the kraken’s lair. A new mysterious material, Kraken’s Ink, has been discovered. A local alchemist was seen purchasing large amounts of the material to transform it into Kraken’s Blood!

[img]http://yppedia.puzzlepirates.com/images/1/1e/Social-Kraken.png[/img]

Be warned! Large ships cannot approach the kraken, as the beast will quickly send them to Davy Jones’ Locker. Ships traveling to a Kraken’s Lair should stock one lifeboat for each pirate aboard. Ye can find this commodity at yer local shipyard. This will allow the crew to approach the kraken in small, maneuverable rowboats. Avoid the tentacles and collect treasure!

Furnisher owners are enthusiastic about the new sea monster hunt and advertisements for specialty rowboats are starting to appear:

[b]Krazy Karen’s Kraken Kraze Klearance![/b]
Kustomize yer rowboat on yer next Kraken Konfrontation!

Bumper Boats!
Chum Boats!
Harpoon Boats!
Powder Boats!
Speed Boats!

*Rowboat Kits last 15 login days.

Kraken’s Lairs is a new [url=http://yppedia.puzzlepirates.com/Official:Sea_Monsters]Sea Monster Hunt[/url]. If yer on a Doubloon Ocean, ye will need a [url=http://yppedia.puzzlepirates.com/Bravery_badge#Bravery_badge]bravery badge[/url]. Pirates on Cerulean will need a [url=http://yppedia.puzzlepirates.com/Subscription]subscription[/url] to participate.

notes.title: Watch out for that tree!
notes.notes:

Be the king of yer own jungle! Enjoy the steamy surroundings as ye play hide and seek with the multitude of monkeys on the ship. Due to the sweltering conditions of the jungle, the cannons look a bit rusty, but they’ll sink the enemy ships just as well as shiny ones!

Wow, that is a big spider! Wouldn’t want to find that crawling on yer shoulder! There is an abundance of wildlife on this ship. Monkeys and parrots in the trees, and a pair of big cats roam the ship. Don’t be bothered by the gators swimming in the pools - these critters don’t venture beyond the water.

After a full day of pillaging, enjoy the comfort of a hammock as ye listen to the soothing sounds of the jungle.

Grab a vine and swing to yer nearest shipyard to order yer Jungle Class Sloop today!

notes.title: Expedition Rally: The Empire Strikes Again!
notes.notes:
The Empire is displeased with recent piracy on the oceans, and has decided to renew its efforts to bring all the archipelago under Imperial control. To do this, the Empire is building numerous small forts, and increasing the marines protecting these outposts.

Ye pirates are more likely to run across Imperial Outpost expeditions while out on the seas. It costs quite a fortune to run an empire and these Imperial ships are carrying more grog and shot during this campaign to control the oceans. If ye face a sinking expedition, the commodities are greatly increased for defeating the enemy!

This Expedition Rally will be active from April 7th at noon PDT until April 14th at noon PDT.

For Freedom!

notes.title: Eggcellent!
notes.notes:
Congratulations to all the talented players whose egg designs were selected to be added to the game this year! Beginning today, egg furniture will be available in the palace shoppe, and as prizes in tournaments and competitions! Now is the perfect time to decorate your home, ships, shop or hall for spring.

BREAKING NEWS NOW - Eggpocalypse 2014!

The Department o' HWFO is gathering reports from around the oceans that eggs have been found broken or cracked! There are unconfirmed reports that strange creatures have been sighted on colonized islands. Frantic Ray yells, 'They've hatched velociraptARRRs!", but Panicked Jane swears the're small and fast.

Frantic pirates were seen running from their homes earlier today, clutching broken egg shells. One shocked pirate was mumbling, ‘I thought it was chocolate inside...’

When we hit the docks looking for information, there were only a handful of pirates to be seen. When asked about the egg hatching theory, Smug Callum declared "When ye originally decorated yer home with giant, unidentified waist-high eggs, ye thought to yerself, 'That looks lovely. What could ever possibly go wrong?' Well, now ye know!" Paranoid Sam's voice whispered, ‘They spy on you for the OMs, you know! The eggs, the pets, even the familiars!’ Only the glint of the sun off his foil hat was visible as he ran into the forest.

Are eggs safe? We'll have all the facts for you tomorrow!

notes.title: Sea of Dream
notes.notes:
The team has been dreaming of this sloop for a long time and now, it is ready! This new sloop has a cabin, and for those extended voyages out to sea, bedrolls for a quick nap on deck.

Just click the bedroll and count some sheep while you drift off to sleep, clutching yer rum jug.

The limited edition Dream Class Sloop will transport yer crew to the land of dreams. Fluffy clouds and numbered sheep will ensure a restful visit to dreamland, so ye can return to the seas refreshed and...wait, do those cannons have arms and legs?

Suddenly this dream is feeling a bit unsettled. What is with that giant flower? Is that sheep following me? Fall through the vortex hatch and enter the surreal hold of the dream ship. Find a giant sleeping turtle and a walking, talking rumjug. While he may not be able to find his hat, only the most skilled pirates will be able to best him in drinking.

Below the hold enter a maze of endless stairways and doors. Don’t let panic set it while ye seek yer way out of this disturbing tangle.

Exhausted from running in the endless stairways, and relieved to have escaped the red room, will ye find a safe haven in the cabin? This nightmare space will not give ye respite from the terror, and ye might wake up in a cold sweat.

Will the sandman bring ye fair dreams or horrifying nightmares? Visit yer local shipyard today, because the Dream Class Sloop will fade away from shoppes on April 3rd.

notes.title: Winter Wonderland
notes.notes:
Bundle up, pirates, because Old Man Winter is here with a limited edition Blizzard Class Sloop that is sure to nip at your toes! Freeze yer enemies in their tracks with icy cannons as ye glide across the frozen seas with the grace and frenzy of a January blizzard.

With a giant snowflake helm, which navigation method do ye prefer? Do ye float across the board with the finesse of a falling snowflake, or do ye smash yer way into rocks and through whirlpools with the fury of a blizzard? If ye get a chill while on the deck, cozy up with the bear rug. I’m sure the snowman would be happy to navigate.

The yeti doll on the main deck looks right at home among the snow blocks, icy cannons and snowflake banners. If ye feel the nip in the air, grab a toasty mug to warm yer hands. Step through the igloo hatch to go below deck and find an indoor winter wonderland.

Grab yer hearties and defend yer flag! Yes, ye should be repairin’ the hull or runnin’ the bilge, but snowball fights are so much fun! The hold includes plenty of obstacles and hiding spots for ye to enjoy the glee found in pelting the other team with a good handful of ferocity! Unfortunately, ye can't really throw the snowballs in the hold. Trickster Jack Frost fused them together into a giant frozen lump, but they sure look inviting!

After the epic battle, thaw out in the cabin. Dip into the mead vat for warming refreshment as ye enjoy the comfort of the crackling fire and a comfy bear rug. Prepare for future snowy adventures with a feast!

Let Jack Frost guide yer crew to enjoy the levity of this frosty season.

Hurry to yer local shipyard today because the Blizzard Class Sloop will melt away after February 12th!

notes.title: Update: DDoS attacks on Puzzle Pirates
notes.notes:
Ahoy mates,

Over the last several months, we've been working to develop a consistent response to the DDoS attacks against Puzzle Pirates. The attacks have been made with increasing frequency, and recent cases appear to be timed to coincide with major in-game events such as blockades.

We've met with some success, but we have not been able to guarantee the game is free from the effects of these attacks. While there is no perfect defense for a DDoS, we will be making an architectural change to the game that should help significantly. This will take a number of weeks to implement.

This project is now our first priority. Implementation will require some planned downtime in the future, and we will update you when we have more information on that.

Thanks for hanging in there, everyone!

Don’t let that stash of fruit rot in the hold of your ship! Old Salts around the ocean have been whispering about markets paying more for fruit and gem thieves being lazy varmints. They also report a parrot squakin’ about merchant and brigand ships sailin' with a mighty fine bit o' booty aboard.

Grab yer hearties and set out to sea to make yer own late fall haul!

  • Markets are paying up to 25% more for fruit.
  • Gem thieves are less active, so large quantities of gems are more likely to make it through a voyage.
  • Merchant brigands are operating at an increased rate and shipping their goods to distant destinations. Their attraction to trading posts is increased.
  • Compelled by an abundance of fruit, encounters with the mischievous Monkey Boat are more common.
  • Brigand and barbarian ships are more attracted to islands with a Black Market and are carrying more booty.

In addition to open markets, Crimson Jim is having an inventory reduction sale! He is including special items free when ye purchase doubloons or subscription time. notes.title: Ye Heavens Aligned!
notes.notes:
MESSAGE FROM YE HEAVENS: Yer daily horoscope reads: Jupiter and Saturn be aligned so.....expand yer time with supernatural craft. We reviewed the astral charts and concluded this could only mean one thing. The Celestial Class Sloop is extended through January 1st, 2014!

This month the stars aligned to produce a limited edition sloop of astronomical significance. Navigators can stow away the sextant while on the Celestial Class Sloop, as the heavens are now within reach. Featuring a star to guide ye and haunted wall lamps to enhance the mystic connection to heavenly beyond, ye should never lose yer way.

In the cabin there are adequate beds and hammocks to allow ye to sleep the day away as ye prepare for yer nocturnal examination of the celestial frontier.

The main deck features a larger-than-life telescope. This astral wonder has been modified to allow access for studious pirates in the hold. Consult charts, celestial globes and books from below deck without the hassle of ordering swabbies to haul them about the ship.

Also in the hold, find access to yer daily horoscope. This sage advice* is customized for each pirate individually and will change daily. Will it help yer pirate navigate difficult waters or find yer true talents? Identify yer zodiac and ponder this otherworldly counsel.

Each ship includes a planetarium below the hold. This space is perfect for yer officers in training - lock em below to learn their navigational points! Do they know where to find Polaris, and where the second star to starboard will lead? Or ye can use it for a party that is out of this world!

Don’t wait for the next planetary alignment, because the Celestial Class Sloop will only be available until December 16, 2013!

*We received notification from 'beyond' that the casks of fine rum offered for supernatural consultation were inadequate. Vargas the Mad provided his expertise in exchange for the rum.
